name: Full-stack (React + Express)
summary: React 19 client and Express 5 API in one workspace with dev proxying.
description: An npm-workspaces project that runs a Vite React client and a typed Express API side by side. The dev server proxies /api to the backend, so the client talks to a same-origin URL in development and a real HTTP API in production.
setupRequirements: npm 10 or newer (workspace scripts delegate to npm)
